g.id: Width and time from regression equations: Froehlich, MacDonald, Von Thun, Xu and Zhang
EMBANKMENT DAM, earth or rockfill: the breach grows by erosion over 0.5 to several hours
Breach = whole monoliths, vertical sides, formed in 0.1 to 0.5 hour
CONCRETE GRAVITY DAM, including RCC: one or more monoliths slide or overturn at the base
Breach = 80 to 100 percent of the crest, in 0.1 hour or less
CONCRETE ARCH DAM: most or all of the dam goes at once
Breach = width of the failed buttresses, near instant
BUTTRESS DAM: one or more buttresses fail
What kind of dam is it?
WADI MAJLAS DAM is RCC gravity: 312 m crest, 72.5 m above the wadi bed. Method followed: monolith based breach with sensitivity on the number of blocks
